description: Long-lived MCP daemon — keeps LSPs (intelephense/pyright/etc) warm across calls. Avoids 30s+ cold-start per invocation.

mcp_daemon.description: Start MCP daemon for SERVER_NAME. Blocking; --detach to background.

mcp_status.description: List running MCP daemons: name, pid, uptime, idle, socket.

mcp_stop.description: Stop MCP daemon SERVER_NAME. SIGTERM, SIGKILL after 3s. `mcp_stop:--all` also reaches the same stop-everything code path as mcp_stop_all (#1315), but mcp_stop_all is the canonical spelling -- use that one directly rather than passing --all as a SERVER_NAME here.

mcp_stop_all.description: Stop every supertool MCP daemon. Canonical op for this (#1315) -- mcp_stop:--all reaches the identical code path but is an undeclared alias, not a separate mode.
